intro: Lake Malawi covers about a fifth of the country.

chapters.title: Lake Malawi
text: Lake Malawi has more fish species than any other lake, including hundreds of colourful cichlids found nowhere else. The Shire River flows south to the Zambezi.

chapters.title: Highlands
text: Mount Mulanje rises to 3,002 m, and the Zomba and Nyika plateaus are cool and green.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Malawi's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
